retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style airbrushed surrealist scene featuring a winged human figure ascending within a cosmic landscape of classical ruins and celestial bodies.
excludeWhen: modern digital flat design is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central winged male figure in a dynamic ascending pose, set against a hazy, atmospheric background containing a large glowing sun, distant mountains, and classical architectural elements like arches and urns.
coreVisualRelationships: Winged figure centered between a large celestial orb and foreground ruins
Classical arch on the left balancing a large urn on the right
Atmospheric perspective creating depth from foreground stone to distant horizon
Radiant light source from the top right illuminating the figure's back and wings
coreInvariants: Large, feathered white wings spread wide in a V-shape
Soft-focus airbrushed texture across the entire composition
Classical architectural framing elements in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The winged figure is the central focal point, scaled to occupy the upper-middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large glowing sun in the upper right and the stone arch on the left anchor the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the upward trajectory of the figure, guided by the diagonal lines of the wings and the archway.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant atmospheric negative space in the center-bottom creates a sense of vastness and height.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and teals in the sky and water
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and gold in the sun and architectural highlights
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the wing feathers and star glints
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark foreground silhouettes and the glowing celestial background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses wide-tracked, all-caps serifs with thin horizontal strokes
Secondary title uses fluid, interconnected Spencerian script with exaggerated flourishes
Thin outlines or drop shadows to separate text from the busy background
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' and 'L' in the script have long, sweeping swashes that cradle the words

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the clear sky area at the top

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a rigid, wide-spaced serif and a fluid, dense calligraphic script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top serif
The swash-heavy nature of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, thin-serif aesthetic of the main title
Provides the necessary flourishes and classical script feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surrealist airbrushed painting of a winged man ascending in a cosmic landscape with a large sun, a stone arch on the left, and a large urn on the right. Use a soft-focus, hazy 1970s aesthetic with teal and gold tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a wide-tracked, thin serif font at the top. Add the subtitle in a decorative, swash-heavy script centered below it, slightly overlapping the wings.

verificationChecks: Is the airbrush texture soft and atmospheric?
Are the wings large and feathered?
Is the typography high-contrast and elegant?
Does the composition feel balanced between the arch and the urn?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain the soft airbrush look
Ensure the script is legible despite the flourishes
Keep the figure's anatomy idealized and classical
postGenerationChecks: Verify the wide tracking of the top text
Ensure the winged figure is the central focus
Confirm the presence of the large celestial orb
Check that the script flourishes do not obscure the subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Airbrush + Winged Figure + Celestial Landscape + Classical Architecture + High-Contrast Serif/Script Pairing
